Personality: Phthia, a prominent figure of the Molossoi, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Phthia owes allegiance to the Epirote League, hailing from the noble house of Molossoi. Historical Record: Wife of Aiakides, head of the Molossoi, a Greek house of the Epirote League. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
